proposal.concept: Northstar names something leaders already trust: the fixed point that orients every decision, every course correction, every late-night call about what the company actually stands for. This set turns that orientation into a shared ritual. A roll-up backgammon board in deep navy, warm gold, and clean white carries the Northstar wordmark across the open waist band in a single, unhurried line. The game is deliberately paired, always requiring two people, always requiring a read of the board, always requiring a move. Around the retreat table it becomes the thing that happens after the agenda ends and the real conversation begins.
materials: Roll-up board in full-grain PU leather, deep navy ground with warm gold and clean white points, Northstar wordmark debossed across the center waist band in tone-on-tone.
Solid brass hardware throughout: precision dice, doubling cube, and checker sets finished in brass and ivory, seated in a molded insert inside a rigid two-piece gift box with ribbon pull.
Laser-engraved leather tube in matching navy, carrying the Northstar name vertically along the side, fitted with a brushed brass end cap and ribbon pull tab.
proposal.note: You navigate by the same star, wherever the year takes you. This set is a reminder of that, and an invitation to keep playing the long game together.
proposal.thesis: A game for leaders who already know where they are going and know they will need each other to get there.
proposal.title: Northstar · Annual Retreat Set
tldr: A luxury roll-up backgammon set in deep navy and warm gold, built around the Northstar name and designed to travel well beyond the retreat.
The game pairs two people, starts real conversations, and keeps the brand present in every room a leader enters for the next twelve months.
Solid brass hardware, full-grain leather, debossed wordmark: a set that reads as considered because it was.
